title: Potent inhibitors targeting cyclin-dependent kinase 9 discovered via virtual high-throughput screening and absolute binding free energy calculations.
authors: Wang, Shipeng; Liu, Fengjiao; Li, Pengfei; Wang, Jia-Ning; Mo, Yan; Lin, Bin; Mei, Ye
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CDK9激酶小分子抑制剂的虚拟筛选与结合自由能计算，对象为蛋白-小分子体系，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Due to the crucial regulatory mechanism of cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) in mRNA transcription, the development of kinase inhibitors targeting CDK9 holds promise as a potential treatment strategy for cancer. A structure-based virtual screening approach has been employed for the discovery of potential novel CDK9 inhibitors. First, compounds with kinase inhibitor characteristics were identified from the ZINC15 database via virtual high-throughput screening. Next, the predicted binding modes were optimized by molecular dynamics simulations, followed by precise estimation of binding affinities using absolute binding free energy calculations based on the free energy perturbation scheme. The binding mode of molecule 006 underwent an inward-to-outward flipping, and the new binding mode exhibited binding affinity comparable to the small molecule T6Q in the crystal structure (PDB ID: 4BCF), highlighting the essential role of molecular dynamics simulation in capturing a plausible binding pose bridging docking and absolute binding free energy calculations. Finally, structural modifications based on these findings further enhanced the binding affinity with CDK9. The results revealed that enhancing the molecule's rigidity through ring formation, while maintaining the major interactions, reduced the entropy loss during the binding process and, thus, enhanced binding affinities.
abstract_zh: 由于细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶9（CDK9）在mRNA转录中的关键调控机制，靶向CDK9的激酶抑制剂开发有望成为癌症的潜在治疗策略。本研究采用基于结构的虚拟筛选方法，以发现潜在的新型CDK9抑制剂。首先，通过虚拟高通量筛选从ZINC15数据库中识别出具有激酶抑制剂特征的化合物。接下来，利用分子动力学模拟优化预测的结合模式，并基于自由能微扰方案通过绝对结合自由能计算精确评估结合亲和力。分子006的结合模式经历了由内向外翻转，新结合模式表现出与晶体结构（PDB ID: 4BCF）中小分子T6Q相当的结合亲和力，这凸显了分子动力学模拟在捕捉连接对接与绝对结合自由能计算的合理结合姿态中的关键作用。最后，基于这些发现的结构修饰进一步增强了与CDK9的结合亲和力。结果表明，通过成环增强分子刚性，同时保持主要相互作用，减少了结合过程中的熵损失，从而增强了结合亲和力。
